responses.reason: "Scope of exemption for rule proposal: Is fully exempt." is a rule-6 exemption statement in its own sentence; §4.2 rule 3 gives separate sentences separate relations, and §1 says to record what the text says. Draft 1 treated it as a restatement in R3 rationale, but it asserts a different scope (whole proposal, not "or portions"), so it is not merely a restatement and it was neither recorded nor listed in out_of_scope_notes, contrary to §10. It attaches to the existing implied target T3 because the sentence names nothing exempted from and the enclosing Regulatory Fairness Act block supplies it, rather than a new rule-6.3 UNRESOLVED target. R3 is preserved as written, including its OR.
